cases.question: When can I enter players in the match lineup?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
You can enter players in the match lineup through LMS using the Match Setup button. Both home and visiting Captains must submit upcoming match rosters no later than three (3) days before the scheduled match.

If changes are needed after the initial submission, they must also be entered through Match Setup, which automatically notifies the opposing Captain(s). Teams that have not completed Match Setup cannot print a completed Match Score Sheet, and repeated late/non-completion may result in forfeiture at League Management’s discretion.

cases.question: How do I enter players on my roster?
cases.answer:
Go to your Captain Dashboard, open Captain Tools, and click Manage Roster. Then click Add Player.

In the Add Player pop-up:
- Your home community is preselected.
- Use the drop-down menu to view available players, including eligibility status and DUPR ratings.
- Select the player and click Add Player to Team.

If the player is missing a DUPR ID or Season Rating, you can still select the player and click Add Player to Team; League Management will be automatically notified to review the issue and update you on the player’s status.

If a player is marked “Not Eligible,” trying to add them will show an on-screen message explaining why.

cases.question: How can I update my roster?
cases.answer:
To update your team roster, go to Captain Tools on your Captain Dashboard and click Manage Roster. From there you can add, change, or remove players.

To add a player: click Add Player, use the drop-down list of available players, and review eligibility status and DUPR ratings.

If a player is missing a DUPR ID or Season Rating, select the player and click Add Player to Team; League Management will be notified to review and update you. If a player is marked “Not Eligible,” the system will show an on-screen message explaining why.

To change a Captain or Co-Captain, use Change Captain/Co-Captain next to your team name; it opens an email draft to submit the request to League Management.

cases.question: How do I enter match scores?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide

cases.answer:
To enter match scores:

1. Open the match and click the red “Enter Match Scores” button. It is available only on or after the scheduled match date.
2. Select the players for each game from the dropdowns. Normally use “Use this saved team” to load the Match Setup team; if there were changes, select the correct player individually.
3. Enter the scores in each game block.
4. Click Submit. The system will check for errors before saving.
5. The opposing captain will receive a verification request and must review the scores, then verify or dispute them. The visiting team captain must verify promptly so results can be entered into DUPR before the end of the weekend.

Important limits: for individual-game forfeits or retirements, refer to the official League Rules when entering results. If the entire match date is forfeited, canceled, or cannot be played because of weather or scheduling conflicts, do not enter it into the system; notify League Management at info@lwrpickleballclub.com. Ineligible players cannot be selected, and score fields are blocked if a line has an eligibility issue.

sources.citation: LWRPC-Captains Guide to the LMS — Page 13
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide — ENTER/VERIFY SCORES — Page 9

cases.question: Does the weekday dupr league use rally scoring

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
No, not generally. The governing default scoring method for the LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League is Standard Scoring under current USAP Rules, unless a particular game or match format expressly requires Rally Scoring.

The supplied Rally Scoring exception is limited to the Weekday DUPR League, 9.1 division Picklebreaker™: only when the match is tied 2–2 after all preceding rounds, the Picklebreaker is one game to 15, win by 2, using Rally Scoring.

cases.question: How does Rally Scoring work?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
Rally Scoring in the LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League works this way:

- A team can win a point whether it is serving or receiving, except for the game-winning point.
- If the serving team loses a rally, it is a side out: the opposing team gets a point and takes over the serve.
- After a side out, the first server is based on that team’s score: right-side player serves if the score is even; left-side player serves if the score is odd.
- Players switch sides only after winning a point on their own serve, and the same player continues serving from the new side.
- When a team reaches one point below the game-winning score, its score freezes. From then on, that team can score the game-winning point only while serving. The other team continues normal Rally Scoring until it also reaches its freeze point.
- In win-by-two games, if the score becomes tied at or beyond the initial freeze point, both teams unfreeze and normal Rally Scoring resumes. The freeze/unfreeze process continues as needed until a team wins by two points, and the game-winning point must always be scored while serving.

sources.citation: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules — DUPR LEAGUE MANAGERS — Page 15

cases.answer:
In a Picklebreaker, Rally Scoring works this way:

- A team can win a point whether it is serving or receiving, except for the game-winning point.
- If the serving team loses a rally, it is a side out: the receiving team gets a point and takes over serve.
- After a side out, the first server is based on that team’s score: right-side player serves on an even score; left-side player serves on an odd score.
- Players switch sides only after winning a point on their own serve, and the same player continues serving from the new side.
- A scoring freeze takes effect when a team reaches one point below the game-winning score. Once frozen, that team can score the game-winning point only while serving. The other team continues normal Rally Scoring until it also reaches its freeze point.
- In a win-by-two format, if the score becomes tied at or beyond the initial freeze point, both teams become unfrozen and normal Rally Scoring resumes. The freeze/unfreeze process continues as needed until one team wins by two points, and the game-winning point must always be scored while serving.

cases.question: How is my Season DUPR calculated?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
Your Season DUPR Rating is established on the date communicated to all captains before the first scheduled league match, and it stays in effect for the whole season.

How it is set:
- DUPR ratings are truncated to the nearest tenth. Example: 3.496 becomes 3.4.
- If your DUPR Reliability Factor is below 29, you are classified as “Not Rated” for league purposes.
- For team aggregate rating calculations, a Not Rated player is initially assigned the division’s maximum individual DUPR rating minus 0.5.
- If you are rostered in multiple divisions, the highest adjusted Season DUPR Rating assigned to you is used consistently across all divisions where you appear.
- In leagues using the Age-based DUPR sub-rating, that sub-rating is used; if a player has not established a 65+ Age-based rating at the start of the season, the 50+ Age-based rating is used.
